summary: Wide lane lined with parked cars and vans, bush behind, homes far off.
reasons: Dozens of cars and vans parked here

drivers.seclusion: Forest on the north side; park and a road to the south; mapped homes are 74 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed road with parking along it; several vans and trucks already stop here.
drivers.traffic: Quiet no-through road beside the park; the busy main road is about 90 m south.
drivers.convention: Rows of parked vehicles, including van-sized ones, so a van blends in.

flags: Steep: about 3 to 6% grade along the road
Heavy parking at busy times, possibly market-related
Slope check: DEM shows up to 22% on the bank beside the road
sun_shade: Mixed: bush on the north gives afternoon shade, open to the sun from the south.

best_section.where: Northern kerb of the road along the bush edge, at the ring and just east
